npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-01.html.text: Magister Clayton: What is it? Oh, a Kamael soldier! There certainly are many similarities between the Kamael and we Dark Elves... But if you have no business with me, I must return to my work.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-02.html.text: Magister Clayton: Ah! What business does a Kamael have with me?

links.text: "I have heard that you are especially interested in our race, so I came to speak with you."

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-07.html.text: Magister Clayton: I require 30 Enmity Crystals. Go hunt Watchmen of the Plains , Roughly-Hewn Rock Golems , the Delu Lizardman Suppliers , the Delu Lizardman Special Agents , the Cursed Seers , the Delu Lizardman Commanders , and Delu Lizardman Shaman to gather 30 Enmity Crystals .

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-08.html.text: Magister Clayton: I see you have obtained all the ingredients. Excellent! Now I can use the materials you brought back to magically manufacture the ingredient my Dwarven Artisan needs.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-10.html.text: Magister Clayton: Ah, finally finished! My magical experiment is actually only a part of a much larger scheme designed to release the seal of our greatest elder. This elder has existed since ancient times, so he may also have been alive when your race was created... As far as I know, your race was …

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-12.html.text: Magister Clayton: How does Blacksmith Poitan in the Town of Dion fare these days?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-13.html.text: Magister Clayton: Have you found the answer to your question? A new race...

Q00136_MoreThanMeetsTheEye/30464-01.html.text: Magister Clayton: What is it? I am in the midst of a particularly sensitive experiment at the moment. You do not appear to have any business with me, so do not waste my time.

Q00136_MoreThanMeetsTheEye/30464-04.html.text: Magister Clayton: Hurry and bring me 5 Glass Jaguar Crystals from the Plains of Dion . The Glass Jaguar appears in the shape of a shining leopard.

Q00136_MoreThanMeetsTheEye/30464-05.html.text: Magister Clayton: Ah, you've brought all the Glass Jaguar Crystals! I will craft a blank Sealbook right away... Q00136_MoreThanMeetsTheEye/30464-06.html.text: Magister Clayton: How fares your experiment? I hope that the empty seal set that I created for you was of some assistance. May you find success!

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30464-01.html.text: Magister Clayton: I don't understand why the Tetrarch would ask an outsider like you to do a job such as this. But I do not doubt the wisdom of Thifiell, and I have always observed the commandments of our race. So despite my reluctance, I will help you. I will tell you what ingredients you must col…

Q00217_TestimonyOfTrust/30464-02.html.text: Magister Clayton: You must collect all three of the ingredients I described to you. Should I tell you one more time? Your race is so impatient that you forget the details! First, go to Death Pass and collect the blood of a Guardian Basilisk . If you have 5 bottles of its blood, it can be refined in…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-03.html.text: Magister Clayton: Yes... There are many similarities between your race and our Dark Elven race... Great strength and combat skills around which both our societies are structured on... Just as we were created for the great purpose of serving Shilen, your race was also created for a certain mission.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-04.html.text: Magister Clayton: Strange that a Kamael like yourself would ask such a question... I wonder whether you are asking in earnest or if there is some other purpose at work here.

links.text: "We are born to be soldiers. Deceit and subterfuge are alien to us. I ask because I genuinely do not know."

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-05.html.text: Magister Clayton: Very well, then. I will make a bargain with you. Grant me one request and I will give you what you seek...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-06.html.text: Magister Clayton: Actually, I had asked a Dwarven Artisan to craft a certain tool I require for my magic experiment. He sent back a list of ingredients that he needs to craft it. Although I have managed to obtain most of the materials on his list, I have had no luck procuring any Enmity Crystals. P…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30464-11.html.text: Magister Clayton: Well then, good luck to you, Kamael. A new race...

Q00136_MoreThanMeetsTheEye/30464-03.html.text: Magister Clayton: Oh this is... I don't know where you're planning to use this, but I've never seen an order like yours before... ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30464-note.text: Magister Clayton: I teach Dark Mystic who seek the will of Shilen. There is nothing I can teach you.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30464.html.text: Magister Clayton: My power is born from Darkness. Sadness, rage, anger and curses are the sources of our power. To perfect oneself in solitude is the destiny of Dark Elven Wizards.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
